title.en: SAMPLE: An AI lab claims a proof of an open problem
title.zh: SAMPLE：AI 實驗室宣稱證明了一個未解問題

found.en: Marlow Labs says its AI system found a proof of an open problem about sums of sets of whole numbers.
found.zh: Marlow Labs 表示，它的 AI 系統找到一個未解問題的證明，這個問題與整數集合的和有關。

matters.en: A proof would settle a question that mathematicians had left open.
matters.zh: 證明若成立，就能解決數學家一直懸而未決的問題。

ai_helped.en: Marlow Labs built the Marlow Prover. The lab says the system found the proof with no human step in the argument.
ai_helped.zh: Marlow Labs 開發了 Marlow Prover。這間實驗室表示，這套系統找到了證明，論證中沒有任何人類的步驟。

how_sure.en: Preprint. arXiv hosts the paper, which has not been peer reviewed. Marlow Labs is the source of the claim.
how_sure.zh: 預印本。論文放在 arXiv 上，尚未經過同儕審查。這項說法的來源是 Marlow Labs。

background.en: A Lean file posted with the paper lets a proof assistant check the argument by machine.
background.zh: 隨論文附上的 Lean 檔案，能讓證明輔助工具（proof assistant）以機器檢查這份論證。

could_lead.en: If the Lean file checks, the proof could be accepted without waiting long for referees.
could_lead.zh: 如果 Lean 檔案通過檢查，這份證明可能不必等待審稿人太久，就被接受。

evidence.quote: The proof was found by the Marlow Prover with no human step in the argument

sources.title: SAMPLE: A proof of an open problem on sums of sets of whole numbers
SAMPLE: SumSets.lean, the Lean proof file
